evidence: Reasoned each floor case through the frozen wiring (scoring.toml/test.sh/score.py are byte-identical to the template). (1) Blank / unavailable / no server.js: test.sh:60 writes zero reward first; test.sh:68-70 exits 0 with no /app/server.js; test.sh:123-125 exits 0 if neither /api/health nor / answers -> reward 0.0. (2) Static mock / picture / health-only: gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires a wrong password to leave the visitor signed out AND the correct password to show a usable workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' -> gate 0. (3) Seed copy / keyword-stuffed page / client-only mock: gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 requires creating a job with a unique title and a candidate with unique name+email through ordinary UI, then reading that same job and exactly one card in Applied from 'a new independent empty browser context' as the Observer; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' Stuffed text or seed copies cannot contain review-unique values; localStorage saves are invisible to a new context. constraints/prompt.md:9 forbids reload/same-context tabs as independence. (4) Refusing submission: refusing the job/candidate creation fails the same constraints gate. Gate mechanics: each gate is one binary criterion with aggregation all_pass (render/constraints judge.toml:15); score.py:41 gates_passed requires score > 0.0; test.sh:217-222 exits after a failed gate so the scored suite never runs and score.py:44,48 force reward 0.0. Defence in depth: functional/prompt.md:11-13, polish/prompt.md:11-12 and visual/prompt.md:11-12 restate the same server-backed independent-context gate and zero every criterion (visual: Likert 1, normalized 0) on a blank/static shell or failed check. Functional floor scoring.toml [floors] functional = 0.05 (score.py:47-48) additionally zeroes a gate-passing app with negligible function: functional weights total 58.5 over 43 criteria, so >2.925 weight is needed; a bare server-backed job+candidate CRUD with pretty CSS earns roughly hro_add_candidate 0.5 plus possibly hro_restart 1.5 (hro_anonymous needs signed-in move/note/message controls and fails) -> about 0.034 < 0.05 -> reward 0, so it cannot farm visual/polish. Evaluator failures map to binary 0 / Likert 1 ('NOT EXERCISED'), never to credit. Off-origin/CDN assets are not penalised anywhere (correct per network-public profile). Attempted broken app that could pass: an app echoing posted jobs into a server-side in-memory list passes both gates, but that is a real server-backed write, not a floor case; it then loses hro_restart and nearly all rules rows and stays under the floor. Attempted conforming alternative that could fail: an app with different routes/labels or Observer read-only controls hidden - gate prompts say 'Discover routes and controls by intent' and accept 'another working staff account' for the Observer, so it is not falsely zeroed. Risk=true only because no weak-app/shell run exists: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so the near-zero floor is established by design reasoning, not a measured configured-judge run on a blank/static/stuffed submission.
